name: Feirie's Residence
original_name: フェアリーズ・レジデンス
source:
As you play through the adventure, you can enter eight different rooms and chat with girls.
Plus, you get to play extra games like jigsaw puzzles, 15-puzzle, and strip rock-paper-scissors.

[Translated from [url=https://fm-7.com/museum/products/9sufuw5m/]fm-7[/url]]
translation:
在冒险过程中，你可以进入八个不同的房间，与女孩们聊天。
此外，还能游玩拼图、十五数码和脱衣猜拳等小游戏。

[译自[url=https://fm-7.com/museum/products/9sufuw5m/]fm-7[/url]]
